info.title: KAC Platform API
info.summary: Calendar, imports and weekly schedule planning API.
info.description:
Versioned JSON API for the KAC calendar application.

All business endpoints live under `/api/v1`. Request and response examples use the seeded development account unless configured otherwise.
Mutating operations validate user input and calendar constraints on the server. Import operations are staged and do not write calendar events until confirmation.

The API contract is generated from Fastify JSON Schemas and is exported as `apps/api/openapi/openapi.json` for the Docusaurus reference.

get.description: Confirms that the API process is accepting requests.
Checks API startup and PostgreSQL connectivity.
Returns the active calendar, profile timezone, categories and occurrences for the configured development account.

post.description: Creates an event after server-side validation and collision checking. Weekly events are saved as a series.

put.description: Updates an event after server-side validation and collision checking. Updating a weekly event edits its series.

delete.description: Deletes a one-off event or an entire weekly series after confirmation by the client.

get.description: Returns weekly targets, working availability, preferred windows, blocked periods, shift templates and the profile concurrency version.

put.description: Atomically updates working constraints, recurring availability, preferred windows, blocked periods and shift templates. Requires the current profileVersion.

post.description: Creates a deterministic draft. If no classes occur in the week, confirmation is required. Published planner shifts are excluded from the planning baseline so a replacement can reduce the previous hours.
Revalidates the draft against current profile/calendar constraints, then atomically publishes the shifts as calendar events. Previous planner-generated events are replaced only after validation.
Marks all unapproved proposals for the week as rejected. Previously accepted calendar events remain unchanged.

get.description: Returns paginated schedule versions, including lifecycle and feasibility status.

get.summary: Get a schedule version by ID
Get latest schedule for a week
get.description: Returns the latest non-rejected version whose week starts on the supplied Monday.

put.summary: Validate and save manual schedule edits
put.description: Validates edits against availability, calendar events, shift templates, weekly and daily limits. Uses expectedVersion to detect concurrent changes.

post.description: Checks imported rows against each other and the calendar. Does not write events.
Stores a proposed import and its initial validation. Calendar records are unchanged until confirmation.
Revalidates the accepted rows and writes the whole accepted batch atomically. Duplicate decisions must be explicit.
Closes the pending import without changing the calendar.
Reads an ICS, text PDF or WAT timetable image, builds a review session and returns collision diagnostics. Does not modify the calendar.
Uses the configured local PDF/image reader and creates a review session. Calendar changes require explicit confirmation.
Starts OAuth PKCE or the local demo consent flow. No Google events are written until import-session confirmation.
Records the demo consent decision. The OAuth flow records its decision at the callback endpoint.

get.description: Google redirects here after consent. The endpoint completes PKCE exchange and renders a short status page.

delete.description: Forgets the one-time connection and drops the in-memory access token.

post.summary: Read events from a Google calendar
post.description: Reads a bounded date range and opens a review session; import confirmation uses the shared imports endpoint.
